description: The people who wrote mentions matching your keywords: name, profile, platform, how many of their posts matched (and how many scored relevant), their sentiment split, when they were first and last seen, and where your outreach stands (owner, stage, last contacted). Filter by platform or name, find one person by handle or profile link (handle), outreach stage (stages), owner (ownerIds, "none" for unowned) or automated (bot accounts, whose posts mostly read machine-made); sort by mentions or recency. Use search_mentions with authorId to read what one person said. Email addresses are not returned over MCP: profile.email is always null (the dashboard and the REST API show it where the person published it).

automated.description: true: only people whose matched posts are mostly machine-made (bot accounts); false: only the rest

handle.description: Find one person by an account: a handle (@jane, u/jane) or a profile or post link (https://x.com/jane). Exact, case-insensitive; add platform to pick one platform

intents.description: At least one mention carrying any of these intents

keywordKinds.description: Mentioned a keyword of any of these kinds (brand, competitor, topic)

linkHosts.description: At least one mention linking to any of these hosts, the host itself or a subdomain of it (octolens.com also matches blog.octolens.com)

minFollowers.description: At least this many followers (unknown reach never matches)

minMentions.description: At least this many matched mentions

minNegative.description: At least this many negative mentions

muted.description: true: only muted people; false: only unmuted; omit: everyone

neverKeywordKinds.description: Never mentioned a keyword of these kinds

newSinceDays.description: First seen within this many days

ownerIds.description: People owned by any of these members (user ids); "none" for people nobody owns

platform.description: Only people with an account on this platform

platforms.description: People with an account on any of these platforms

q.description: Match the display name or the profile handle/url

segmentId.description: A saved segment (from list_segments) applied on top of the other filters

since.description: Only people whose first matched mention is at or after this instant (ISO 8601, or epoch ms): new voices

sort.description: "mentions": most matches first; "recent": last seen first; "reach": most followers first; "new": first seen most recently first

stages.description: People at any of these outreach stages (not_contacted, contacted, replied, in_talks, customer, not_a_fit)

items.description: Where your workspace stands with the person: not_contacted, contacted, replied, in_talks, customer or not_a_fit.

tags.description: People carrying any of these tags

name: list_people
title: List people
